component-o.description-s: 2.7-23V adjustable current-limit eFuse with OVLO, 0.5-6A ILIM, 500ns short-circuit response, 28mΩ Ron, hot-swap, reverse current blocking, auto-retry, QFN-10

cfgpins-ao.1c: Active high enable; resistor divider from IN to GND sets UVLO threshold; do not float

cfgpins-ao.2c: Resistor divider from IN to GND sets OVLO threshold; can be used as active-low enable; do not float

cfgpins-ao.3c: Active high open-drain output indicating input supply valid and inrush complete; pull up to logic supply

cfgpins-ao.4c: Active low open-drain fault indicator; pull up to logic supply

cfgpins-ao.7c: Capacitor from pin to GND sets output rising slew rate; leave open for fastest slew rate

cfgpins-ao.9c: Resistor from pin to GND sets overcurrent threshold and provides analog current monitor output; do not float; mandatory

cfgpins-ao.10c: Capacitor from pin to GND sets overcurrent blanking interval; leave open for fastest response
